games.comingSoonText: New games are being developed. Check back later for more interactive experiences.

jump-game.title: Jump Game
jump-game.description: A classic jump-and-dodge arcade game. Press any key to jump over obstacles and rack up points!
jump-game.longDescription: Test your reflexes in this fast-paced endless runner! Your character automatically runs forward while you time your jumps to avoid obstacles. The game speeds up as your score increases, making it progressively more challenging. How far can you go?
howToPlay: Press SPACE or click to jump
Avoid obstacles by timing your jumps
The game speeds up as you progress
Try to beat your high score!

tic-tac-toe.title: Tic Tac Toe
tic-tac-toe.description: Challenge the AI in this classic strategy game! Choose from Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty and test your skills.
tic-tac-toe.longDescription: The timeless game of X's and O's! Play against an AI opponent with three difficulty levels. On Easy, the AI makes random moves. Medium uses basic strategy, while Hard implements the perfect Minimax algorithm - can you force a draw against an unbeatable opponent?
howToPlay: Click on any empty cell to place your mark
Get three in a row (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal) to win
Block your opponent from getting three in a row
Choose your difficulty before starting

gomoku.title: Gomoku
gomoku.description: Five in a Row! Strategic board game with AI using minimax and alpha-beta pruning. Can you outsmart the algorithm?
gomoku.longDescription: Also known as Five in a Row or Gobang, this ancient strategy game originated in Japan. Place stones on a 15x15 board and try to get exactly five in a row before your opponent. Our AI uses the Minimax algorithm with Alpha-Beta pruning for efficient decision making. A perfect blend of simple rules and deep strategy!
howToPlay: Click on any intersection to place your stone
Get exactly five stones in a row to win
Horizontal, vertical, and diagonal lines count
Block your opponent while building your own lines
features: Advanced AI with Minimax + Alpha-Beta pruning

tetris.title: Tetris
tetris.description: Classic block-stacking puzzle game. Clear lines by completing horizontal rows. Speed increases as you level up!
tetris.longDescription: The legendary puzzle game that has captivated players for decades! Rotate and position falling tetrominoes to complete horizontal lines. Clear multiple lines at once for bonus points. Watch out - the pieces fall faster as you level up! Features the classic seven tetromino shapes and ghost piece preview.
howToPlay: Arrow keys: Move left/right and soft drop
Up arrow or Z: Rotate piece
Space: Hard drop (instant placement)
Complete full horizontal lines to clear them

shogi.title: Shogi
shogi.description: Japanese Chess! Strategic board game with piece drops and promotions. Challenge the AI in this classic strategy game!
shogi.longDescription: Experience the depth of Japanese chess! Unlike Western chess, captured pieces can be dropped back onto the board as your own - adding incredible strategic complexity. Pieces promote when reaching the enemy camp, gaining new powers. Our AI uses advanced evaluation with multiple difficulty levels. Master the way of the general!
howToPlay: Click a piece to select, then click destination
Captured pieces appear in your hand
Drop captured pieces by selecting from your hand
Pieces promote when reaching the last 3 rows
Checkmate the opponent's King to win

othello.title: Othello
othello.description: Classic strategy board game with AI using alpha-beta search. Flip your opponent's discs to win!
othello.longDescription: Also known as Reversi, this elegant strategy game is simple to learn but difficult to master. Place your disc to flip opponent's pieces trapped between your discs. Control the corners and edges for strategic advantage! Our AI uses Alpha-Beta search with position evaluation to provide a challenging opponent.
howToPlay: Click on a valid position to place your disc
Flip opponent's discs by trapping them
A move must flip at least one opponent disc
Game ends when neither player can move
Most discs on the board wins!

mini-adventure.title: Mini Adventure
mini-adventure.description: Roguelike dungeon crawler! Descend 10 floors, manage your torch, and defeat the Dragon boss!
mini-adventure.longDescription: Embark on a procedurally generated dungeon adventure! Navigate through 10 increasingly difficult floors, managing your health, torch light, and resources. Encounter various enemies, find treasures, and prepare for the ultimate challenge - the Dragon boss on floor 10! Every run is different thanks to random generation.
howToPlay: Arrow keys or WASD to move
Bump into enemies to attack
Collect items and gold
Manage your torch - darkness is dangerous!
Reach floor 10 and defeat the Dragon

animal-roleplay.title: Animal Roleplay Survival
animal-roleplay.description: Become an animal and survive 10 turns. Choose actions each turn to manage HP and hunger and reach the best score.
animal-roleplay.longDescription: Choose an animal and survive the wild for 10 turns. Each turn brings a new event. Pick the best action based on your animal's strengths. If HP or hunger reaches zero, the run ends immediately.
howToPlay: Choose one animal before you start
Each turn, check the event and choose one action
Balance HP and hunger while earning score
Survive all 10 turns to clear the game
If HP or hunger reaches 0, the run ends
features: 4 playable animals with different stat profiles
Recent turn log with HP/Hunger/Score deltas
Quick replay with same or different animal

ui.selectAnimalDescription: Select an animal and start your survival run. Match your actions to your strengths.

breakout.title: Breakout
breakout.description: Classic brick-breaking arcade game! Use your paddle to bounce the ball and destroy all bricks. Collect power-ups!
breakout.longDescription: The arcade classic that started it all! Control your paddle to keep the ball in play and break all the bricks. Different colored bricks have different durability. Collect falling power-ups for paddle size changes, multi-ball, and more! Clear all bricks to advance to the next level.
howToPlay: Move mouse or arrow keys to control paddle
Bounce the ball to break bricks
Catch falling power-ups
Don't let the ball fall below the paddle!
Break all bricks to win
features: Multiple brick types with different HP

space-invaders.title: Space Invaders
space-invaders.description: Defend Earth from alien invasion! Destroy waves of enemies, use shields for cover, and shoot the mystery UFO for bonus points.
space-invaders.longDescription: The legendary 1978 arcade shooter comes to your browser! Defend Earth against waves of descending aliens. Use your destructible shields for cover, and don't miss the mystery UFO flying across the top for bonus points! As waves progress, aliens move faster and become more aggressive. How many waves can you survive?
howToPlay: Arrow keys: Move left/right
Space: Fire laser
Destroy all aliens to complete the wave
Use shields for protection
Shoot the mystery UFO for bonus points

daifugo.title: Daifugo
daifugo.description: Play Daifugo (Rich Man Poor Man) vs AI (3-6 players) or online (3-6 players). Create a room, share the code, and battle to empty your hand first!
daifugo.longDescription: The popular Japanese card game also known as "Rich Man, Poor Man"! Play against AI opponents or challenge friends online. Features include Revolution, Eight-cut, Eleven-back, Suit lock (Shibari), and Gekishiba. The goal is to be the first to empty your hand. Rankings carry over between rounds with card exchanges!
howToPlay: Play cards that beat the previous play
Same suit consecutive = Shibari (suit lock)
Same suit + consecutive rank = Gekishiba (exact rank required)
Play 4+ cards for Revolution (reverses strength)
J triggers Eleven-back (temporary reverse)
8 clears the table (Eight-cut)
First to empty hand becomes Daifugo!

ui.chooseAICount: Choose AI count (min 2, max 5) — total 3–6 players.
ui.sevenGiveDesc: Select cards to give (unselected will auto-pick weakest)

menu.chooseMode: Choose a mode to start playing.
menu.modeDesc: AI mode lets you choose how many AI opponents to include (minimum 2, maximum 5). Online mode uses room codes to play with friends (3–6 players).

shichinarabe.title: Shichinarabe
shichinarabe.description: Play Shichinarabe (Sevens) vs AI (3–6 players) or online (3–6 players). Build sequences around the 7s and be the first to empty your hand!
shichinarabe.longDescription: Shichinarabe, also known as "Sevens", is a classic card game where all 7s start on the table. On your turn, play a card that extends a suit sequence (e.g., 6 or 8 next to a 7), or pass if you can't. Pass too many times and you'll be eliminated—so plan ahead and manage your hand carefully.
howToPlay: All 7s are placed on the table at the start
On your turn, play a card adjacent to an existing sequence in the same suit
If you have no playable cards, pass
After 3 passes, you are eliminated
The game ends when everyone has finished or been eliminated

doubt.title: Doubt
doubt.description: Play Doubt (Cheat/Bluff) vs AI (3–6 players) or online (3–6 players). Play cards face-down, claim the rank, and call Doubt to catch liars!
doubt.longDescription: Doubt (also known as "Cheat" or "I Doubt It") is a bluffing card game. Players take turns placing 1–4 cards face-down while claiming they match the required rank (A→K loop). The next player can accept the claim or call Doubt. If the claim was false, the liar takes the pile; if it was true, the doubter takes the pile. Get rid of all your cards to win!
howToPlay: On your turn, place 1–4 cards face-down and claim the required rank
The next player chooses Accept or calls Doubt
If the claim was a lie, the claimant takes the pile
If the claim was true, the doubter takes the pile
Be the first to get rid of all your cards

reverse-jump.title: Reverse Jump
reverse-jump.description: Controls reverse every 8 seconds. Jump low obstacles and duck high bars to survive.
reverse-jump.longDescription: Reverse Jump is an endless reflex game where your controls flip on a timer. One moment Space jumps, the next moment Space ducks. Low obstacles require jumps while overhead bars require crouching, so you need to react and rewire fast.
howToPlay: Space / Up: primary action
Down: secondary action
Controls swap every 8 seconds
Jump low blocks and duck overhead bars
Survive as long as possible

ghost-tetris.title: Ghost Tetris
ghost-tetris.description: Locked blocks fade after 2 seconds. Remember the board and keep clearing lines.
ghost-tetris.longDescription: A memory-focused Tetris variant. Once a piece locks, it starts fading quickly, forcing you to track the structure mentally rather than visually. The core controls stay classic, but your brain does the heavy lifting.
howToPlay: Left/Right to move
Down to soft drop
Up or Z to rotate
Space to hard drop
Clear lines before your memory fails

chaos-breakout.title: Chaos Breakout
chaos-breakout.description: Breakout with chaos pulses: gravity, speed, and paddle size change every 10 seconds.
chaos-breakout.longDescription: Chaos Breakout keeps the classic brick-breaking core, then mutates it in real time. Every 10 seconds, the game applies a random modifier such as gravity direction changes, speed bursts, or paddle width shifts, creating unpredictable runs.
howToPlay: Arrow keys or A/D to move paddle
Bounce the ball and break all bricks
Adapt to chaos events every 10 seconds
Avoid losing all lives
Clear stages to continue

doubt-word.title: Doubt Word
doubt-word.description: A bluff duel using claimed word initials and lengths. Believe or call Doubt.
doubt-word.longDescription: Doubt Word is a social-deduction mini game versus AI. Players claim they have a word with a specific first letter and length, then the opponent decides to believe or challenge. Both truth and deception are viable strategies.
howToPlay: Read AI claims and choose Believe or Doubt
On your turn, choose a word and optionally bluff
If a challenge is correct, challenger gains advantage
If challenge is wrong, challenger is punished
Reduce opponent lives to zero

timed-button.title: Timed Button
timed-button.description: One button mind game: pass the bomb before the hidden timer explodes.
timed-button.longDescription: Timed Button is a minimal psychological duel. The bomb timer is always ticking and either player can pass it. Press too early and you give control away; press too late and it explodes in your hands.
howToPlay: If you hold the bomb, press to pass it
Cooldown prevents spam passing
Explosion gives a point to the opponent
Rounds continue automatically
First to 5 points wins

mirror-othello.title: Mirror Othello
mirror-othello.description: An Othello variant where the board mirrors every 4 turns.
mirror-othello.longDescription: Mirror Othello keeps the normal disc-flip rules but introduces a periodic board mirror effect. Every 4 moves, all discs flip left-right positions, breaking long-term plans and forcing on-the-fly adaptation.
howToPlay: Place a disc to flip opponent discs
Valid moves are highlighted
Board mirrors every 4 total moves
Pass occurs when no legal move exists
Most discs at the end wins

memory-maze.title: Memory Maze
memory-maze.description: Memorize the maze quickly, then navigate to the goal in near darkness.
memory-maze.longDescription: Memory Maze gives you only a few seconds to study the full map. After that, walls are mostly hidden and you must rely on memory and partial local visibility to reach the goal before time runs out.
howToPlay: Memorize the maze during preview
Use Arrow keys or WASD to move
Avoid walls while navigating in dark mode
Reach the green goal tile
Clear stages with shrinking time

daily-move-puzzle.title: Daily One-Move Puzzle
daily-move-puzzle.description: A daily tic-tac-toe puzzle: find the winning move in one turn.
daily-move-puzzle.longDescription: Each day you get one short tactical board and one objective: find the immediate winning move. The puzzle rotates daily by date, making it easy to share results and compare attempts.
howToPlay: Read the side-to-move prompt
Tap an empty square for your answer
Find the instant winning move
Retry to lower attempt count
Copy and share your result

about.title: Biography
about.biographyText: Hi, I'm Yudai, a full-stack engineer cultivating solutions from the vibrant tech hub of San Francisco. My career is a testament to the practical application of classroom knowledge, where concepts learned have been transformed into functional digital tools. I've had the pleasure of creating the Tokachi Musubi website, a platform that allows food truck owners to seamlessly manage their culinary offerings. My portfolio also includes engaging applications like a custom AI for Gomoku, showcasing my commitment to interactive and thoughtful software design. In the professional sphere, I've contributed to robust payment systems, honing my skills in a high-volume, team-oriented environment. Beyond my work, I am dedicated to personal growth, exploring AI and machine learning as part of my continuous learning journey. It's this blend of professional experience and personal exploration that fuels my passion for developing technologies that not only function but also fascinate and inspire.
